blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY— The Department of Agriculture (DA) is assessing an unusually large carabao in Northern Samar for possible use in a breeding and conservation program aimed at improving the province’s livestock production. Assistant Secretary for Ruminant Livestock Benjamin Albarece led a DA technical mission to San Roque, Northern Samar, on Tuesday, Sept. 15, to inspect the animal and explore its potential genetic value for the province’s carabao industry. The inspection was conducted with the Provincial Agriculture and Veterinary Offices headed by Dr. Jose Luis Acompañado, with San Roque Mayor Mary Ann Avalon accompanying the team.
